slides.headline: a full moon *eclipse* in virgo, one week out. the subtle kind
penumbral means the moon only grazes our *shadow*
slides.body: the full moon passes through earth's faint outer shadow and misses the dark core. most people see no change at all, or a slight greying on one edge.

slides.headline: a quiet ending: the *habit* you keep fixing
slides.body: astrologers read full moons as endings and eclipses as fast ones. in virgo: the routine, the to-do list, the way you edit yourself for people. a week to notice.
